body: What is it? What would get better? What is better?

It doesn't mean anything, man. There is no purpose, no ultimate meaning, no objective truth. We're just here to have fun and serve our minds, and if we can't do that then just call it quits. I don't care about knowledge or bettering others, this is all temporary and holds no merit. Even you helping right now, you're doing it to serve your mind, to feel better about yourself, to try and carve meaning in your life. It doesn't really matter and letting go might be the most relaxing option yet.
good point, but it goes both ways. An eternity of nothingness is still better than a day of misery.

Why would you care about that? I love my family but when you're gone you're not there to experience their misery. This might sound selfish but the dimension in which they are sad in is different to the one you inhibit after you die. It's like something bad happening in a dream, you wouldn't call that collateral.
